definitions.explanation: Describes something so common that it is unremarkable or uninteresting. Often carries a slightly dismissive or negative nuance, implying a lack of originality or distinction.

examples.japanese: ありふれた⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
ありふれた⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{幸|しあわ}せ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is happiness even in ordinary daily life.

examples.japanese: ありふれた⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{個性的|こせいてき}→個性的：14922_koseiteki⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He has a common name, but he is a very unique person.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
This is the past-tense form of the verb {有|あ}り{触|ふ}れる (to be commonly found), but it functions as a prenominal adjective modifying nouns directly. The base verb form ⟦ありふれる→ありふれる：10218_arifureru⟧ is rarely used on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ありふれた⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (a commonplace story)
- ありふれた⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧ (ordinary daily life)
- ありふれた⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧ (a common sight)
- ありふれた⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧ (a common name)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平凡|へいぼん}→平凡：12425_heibon⟧: ordinary, mediocre (na-adjective, more neutral)
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧: normal, ordinary (more neutral, no negative nuance)
